propositions: An optional isolated adapter harvests coverage % and CI-health metrics from GitHub Actions run history so trends no longer depend on GHA's short log-retention window.

The adapter parses the pytest-cov TOTAL coverage line from run-log tail via anchored word-boundary matching and extracts CI-health (status, duration, red->green recovery, flake/recheck rate) from run-metadata JSON.
Harvested data is persisted as labeled snapshots to the git-tracked .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson store, not the gitignored reports/ path.

The .github/workflows/test.yml is deliberately not edited to commit snapshots because CI has read-only permissions and ephemeral checkouts; the harvester script writes snapshots after the fact instead.
A portability guard ensures core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py, and future _commands/metrics.py) never import the GHA adapter.
Unit tests use fixture log text and run-metadata JSON with no network, asserting parsed coverage equals 84.2 and correct red->green recovery duration.
